name: Kroger Grocery Distribution Center Keller TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Staffed check-in guardhouse with drive-through canopy sits ~150m inside the entrance off Kroger Dr, controlling the truck lanes (confirmed in Street View 2024-12 and z20 satellite). Entrance from the public arterial is open but all trucks funnel through the guardhouse checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Tan canopy-roofed booth in the median between inbound/outbound truck lanes at ~32.9119,-97.2661; multi-side windows, ~1-2 vehicle footprint, drive-through canopy. Clearly a staffed guard/check-in shack, not the main office.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron with substantial unused width around the guardhouse; ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Long dock bank on the south face plus a separate dock cluster at the SE corner and along the west building face; likely separate ship/receive banks but not definitively confirmed from overhead (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive dedicated trailer drop yard fills the entire north/northwest of the site with hundreds of parked trailers in rows.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main warehouse (very large, tan/white roof), an attached/adjacent 2-story corporate office on the south frontage, and a separate maintenance/fuel building within the west drop yard (~32.9128,-97.2674).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate from the long south dock face + SE bank; building south wall runs ~650m. Approximate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Inbound/outbound lanes split around the guardhouse booth; ~2 each, estimated from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Embedded in dense Fort Worth/Keller suburban metro fabric, surrounded on north and west by large residential subdivisions.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter polygon (~98 acres), traced inside the fence/buffer lines.

citations.claim: Kroger corporate logistics page lists Keller | Dallas 5801 Kroger Drive, Keller TX 76248 as an active Kroger distribution center (Dallas division).

verification.rationale: Kroger corporate logistics page lists Keller TX DC as active; 2025-26 closures were FL/WI/MD fulfillment centers, not this DC.
